h1: Custom 8 oz Barware for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Shop custom 8 oz barware for your next event. Perfect for corporate gifts and promotions. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 8 oz barware hits the sweet spot between a standard shot and a full rocks glass, making it ideal for serving spirits, cocktails, or dessert shooters at corporate events. Whether you are outfitting a company holiday party or stocking an employee break room, this size offers versatility without over-pouring. Choose from double old-fashioned glasses, stemless tumblers, or stackable shot glasses, all available with your logo engraved or screen printed in one color.
heroAltText: Custom 8 oz barware with engraved logo, clear glass double old-fashioned glasses for corporate gifts
